chapters.title: Cold Start
chapters.subtitle: You wake alone. The room has been waiting a long time.

chapters.title: Two Of You
chapters.subtitle: Someone retraces your steps exactly, one take behind.

chapters.title: Held Open
chapters.subtitle: Every door here needs a hand you no longer have.

chapters.title: Interference
chapters.subtitle: The facility studied your habits, then built rooms out of them.

chapters.title: Something Follows
chapters.subtitle: It does not hunt you. It hunts where you have been.

chapters.title: The World Remembers
chapters.subtitle: Nothing here is new. All of it is yours, replayed.

chapters.title: What You Leave Behind
chapters.subtitle: Five of you standing still so one of you can walk out.
